name: achar-infra
description: The AWS CDK app for the Achar backend — the API, and the data, media, auth and webhooks it stands on.

scripts.deploy:dev: npm run bundle && cdk deploy --all --context stage=dev
scripts.deploy:data: npm run bundle && cdk deploy AcharDataStack-dev
scripts.deploy:media: npm run bundle && cdk deploy AcharMediaStack-dev
scripts.deploy:auth: npm run bundle && cdk deploy AcharAuthStack-dev
scripts.deploy:webhooks: npm run bundle && cdk deploy AcharWebhookStack-dev
scripts.deploy:api: npm run bundle && cdk deploy AcharApiStack-dev
